title: AlignmentLink
description:
A tree's link to an alignment. Schema 1: the linked file, by path, size,
modification time and hash; no copy is kept (D25). Schema 2: the exact
input of the analysis run that inferred the tree.

basecraft.description: The basecraft version that wrote this file.

inferred.description: False for an explicitly associated imported tree: matching names is not inference provenance.

source_hash.description: Schema 1: the linked file's hash. Schema 2: the original's, if known.

source_stamp.description:
Schema 1: the linked file's size and modification time when its hash
was last checked.

submitted_hash.description: Schema 2: the hash of the exact alignment the run used.

FileStamp.description:
Cheap change signal captured during an existing verified read. Matching time
and length alone do not prove content identity.
